goal: Never lose existing 72-question learning history when the 160-question bank is introduced.
rules: Do not rewrite a legacy attempt onto a new Level2 question solely because their categories match.
Retain every legacy attempt under its original legacyQuestionId (or a stable generated LEGACY72-* id).
Legacy history remains visible in overall learning history even if the legacy question is no longer in the active practice pool.
Merge legacy stats into a new Level2 question only after an explicit content-equivalence mapping is verified.
A category change is never evidence that two question identities are the same.
Until an old72->new160 equivalence map is verified, new160 seen/unseen status is independent of legacy72 history.
status: policy-ready; exact old72->new160 identity mapping requires the current 72-question bank/IDs from the app.
